teaser: At two in the morning, the house is quiet and the mind is not. This is a sequence many a life path 7 person knows, and inside it sits the questioner that is INTJ: searching for the order under the surface of things until the surface stops mattering. The 7 doubts the given answer; the INTJ insists on building a better one before trusting any answer at all. Crossed, the two don't just ask questions — they refuse to put the question down until it has been taken apart and reassembled correctly, which can take longer than anyone else at the table is prepared to wait.
excerpt: Three boxes left to unpack, and you've stopped — not because the work is done, but because a question arrived mid-task and demands following through.
